exact: GDP-fucose transport across endoplasmic reticulum membrane
GDP-fucose transport into endoplasmic reticulum lumen

definition: The directed movement of GDP-fucose into the endoplasmic reticulum lumen. GDP-fucose is a substance composed of fucose in glycosidic linkage with guanosine diphosphate.
label: GDP-fucose import into endoplasmic reticulum lumen
